scripts.check: bun run specs && bun run --cwd packages/react-native-nitro-wallet build:plugin && bun run --cwd packages/react-native-nitro-wallet typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/react-native-nitro-wallet lint-ci && bun run --cwd apps/example lint && bunx tsc --noEmit -p apps/example/tsconfig.json && bun run test
scripts.prerelease: bun run check && bun run lint:native && bun run --cwd packages/react-native-nitro-wallet pack:dry-run
scripts.lint:native: bun run lint:swift && bun run lint:kotlin
scripts.format:native: bun run format:swift && bun run format:kotlin
scripts.lint:swift: bun run lint:swiftformat && bun run lint:swiftlint
scripts.format:swift: scripts/require-native-tool.sh swiftformat 'Install with: brew install swiftformat' && swiftformat --config config/.swiftformat packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/ios apps/example/ios/WalletExample
scripts.lint:swiftformat: scripts/require-native-tool.sh swiftformat 'Install with: brew install swiftformat' && swiftformat --lint --config config/.swiftformat --reporter github-actions-log packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/ios apps/example/ios/WalletExample
scripts.lint:swiftlint: scripts/require-native-tool.sh swiftlint 'Install with: brew install swiftlint' && swiftlint lint --config config/.swiftlint.yml --strict packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/ios apps/example/ios/WalletExample
scripts.lint:kotlin: bun run lint:ktlint && bun run lint:detekt
scripts.format:kotlin: scripts/require-native-tool.sh ktlint 'Install with: brew install ktlint' && ktlint --format 'packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/android/src/main/java/**/*.kt' 'apps/example/android/app/src/main/java/**/*.kt'
scripts.lint:ktlint: scripts/require-native-tool.sh ktlint 'Install with: brew install ktlint' && ktlint 'packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/android/src/main/java/**/*.kt' 'apps/example/android/app/src/main/java/**/*.kt'
scripts.lint:detekt: scripts/require-native-tool.sh detekt 'Install with: brew install detekt' && detekt --build-upon-default-config --config config/detekt.yml --input packages/react-native-nitro-wallet/android/src/main/java,apps/example/android/app/src/main/java
